event.description: Tie the thirteenth-closest positional scalar groups
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 2,106 parameters at 99.050000%, a +0.050000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 16 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0073, the twelfth positional union at 2,106 parameters and 99.05%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0034. The closest current groups have representatives 335 and 48, values 0.0029729181 and 0.0029764434, differing by 3.525e-6. Hypothesis: unioning these scalar groups with a multiplicity-weighted mean preserves qualification and yields 2,105 parameters. This is more informative than any other untested merge because it is the current minimum-distortion positional union.
